game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Basalt Stair Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair, a basalt column stairway: the forge smith must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before magma slimes spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair: a basalt column stairway
core_gameplay_loop: In Basalt Stair, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before magma slimes spring the trap. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the ash barrier using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The ash barrier reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the ash barrier is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mixed Type Oracle' (Week 2 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Basalt Stair'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Basalt Stair.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ash barrier reached with actions_used <= 17.
